full_judgment: 4. Defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material statements made in the plaint. His case, in short, is that Charag Ali Munshi, father of the defendant got title and possession of the suit land after obtaining settlement. After that, he died leaving behind four sons and three daughters as heirs and by amicable settlement, defendant No. 1 and his brother, Tofazzal got possession of the suit land as well as other land. The defendant stated that during S.A. operation, the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 2 and for that reason defendant No. 2 executed and registered the alleged 'nadabi' deed in favour of defendant No. 1. The scribe mistakenly wrote the deed, of sale in place of 'nadabi' deed. As such, defendant No. 1 filed Title Suit No. 487 of 1977 before the then Third Munsif Court (now Assistant Judge), Comilla and defendant Nos. 1 and 2 obtained decree by way of solenama. The defendant 'further stated that the plaintiff knew about the compromise decree of Title Suit No. 487 of 1977 and the sole compromise decree was legally obtained by the defendant and that the plaintiff on false statements filed the suit.
